variation: Barbell Romanian deadlift, double-overhand grip, hip-width stance and softly bent knees.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter, facing left, showing hip hinge and both grips.
equipment: Straight barbell with one equal modest round plate per side.
invariants: Small knee bend stays approximately constant

frames.label: Set up
frames.cue: Stand tall with soft knees and the bar close to your thighs.
frames.state: Standing start; long arms; hips neutral without leaning back.

frames.label: Begin hinge
frames.cue: Push your hips back while keeping the bar close.
frames.state: Small hip hinge, bar descends thighs, knees stay soft.

frames.label: Continue hinge
frames.cue: Lower along your legs with a long, braced spine.
frames.state: Middle hinge, torso angled forward, bar near knees.

frames.label: Bottom hinge
frames.cue: Stop at your hamstring limit with your back position held.
frames.state: Comfortable hinge endpoint with bar just below knees; no forced mid-shin depth.

frames.label: Drive hips forward
frames.cue: Stand by bringing your hips forward under your torso.

frames.label: Finish standing
frames.state: Same as frame2 on ascent; loop completes to1.
